policy.default: Any active TAI occurrence is a defect unless it matches an approved entry below.

entries.location: Git commit, tag, pull-request and issue history outside the active working tree
entries.reason: Rewriting source-control and review history would destroy provenance and invalidate existing evidence.

entries.location: Already emitted, hashed or signed release/model/production evidence
entries.reason: The recorded identifier must remain byte-for-byte consistent with the artifact and release it proves.

entries.location: Previously executed immutable migration directories and checksums
entries.reason: Changing an executed migration creates checksum drift and destroys reproducible database history.

entries.location: Previously signed contracts, issued invoices, acts and archived legal documents
entries.reason: Historical legal documents must preserve the product name used when they were executed.

instructions: Do not add a temporary entry without a concrete location or path pattern.
Every temporary entry must identify the consuming system and telemetry used to prove zero use.
Every temporary entry must have a real review date and a measurable removal condition.
A broad path such as apps/tai/** is not an acceptable compatibility exception.
Public UI copy can never be allowlisted as immutable history.
